Subject: Final FCST readiness — close-window verification and stage scrub

Team —

Finance is locking the weekly forecast at 5PM PT today. Quick, focused asks so we don't carry noise into the lock: 

1) For every open opportunity assigned to you that is marked Commit/Best Case, confirm the Close Date is realistic. If it's slipped beyond Dec 31, mark it "No Commit" and add a one-line reason in the comment field.

2) Move any deals that are missing a Stage (or still in Prospecting) but have a product eval scheduled out of Commit/Best Case.

3) Mark stale opportunities (no activity in last 30 days) as "Stale" and set next step or reassign.

I dropped a short checklist and a snapshot of the Acme deal in the thread attachments for reference. Please do the updates in Salesforce and ping this thread when done. Finance will pull the report at 4:30PM PT for our last review.

Urgency: HIGH — this directly impacts the Q4 revenue commit and executive forecast.

Thanks,
Sergio
